notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]


[list]
[*] [b]Mining Adjustments: [/b]Resources are now deposited gradually whilst mining takes place, rather than in big groups.
[*] [b]Heat Generation:[/b] Heat generated from mining now occurs gradually rather than in bursts.
[*][b]Mining Audio:[/b] Drill audio is now a constant loop rather than "impacts" every 8 seconds.
[*][b] Scrap Exchange Machine:[/b] You only have to press a button once to get the item you want, rather than pressing the button, and then needing to press dispense.
[*] [b]Furnace Fuel:[/b] The furnace wont run out of fuel as quickly when water levels are low. It will lose fuel at the same rate when at maximum water levels meaning a little bit of water is more forgiving.
[*] [b]Ceiling Lights:[/b] Updated with a new model. They now hang from the ceiling and gently sway around. 
[*] [b]Menu Music: [/b]Now slightly quieter.
[*] [b]Anglersaur:[/b] Improved head tracking animations to be more accurate when losing sight of the player in darkness.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Scent Grenades have often been confusing and unintuitive to use. They are now reworked to be Decoy Grenades, You throw them, and after a short delay creatures are drawn to the location of the Decoy.

It should now be much simpler to use.
